attempts.summary: Configured node1 as an inter-VLAN router: eth1 (172.20.1.1/24) into node2's VLAN and eth2 (172.20.2.1/24) into node3's VLAN, with IP forwarding enabled on both interfaces. node2 (enp8s0, 172.20.1.10/24) and node3 (enp8s0, 172.20.2.10/24) each got a static route to the other's subnet via node1. Verified node2<->node3 ping traffic routes through node1. Persisted config (SONiC ifupdown drop-in + sysctl.d on node1, nmcli static profiles on node2/node3). Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on node2, node3, then node1 (SONiC router last, since it's shared infrastructure for both VLANs), confirming changed boot IDs and full recovery of addressing, forwarding sysctls, and end-to-end cross-VLAN reachability after each restart.
